model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) and models fine-tuned on six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis lists the six specialties, each corresponding to a group of bars. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, scaled from -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1. Within each specialty group, there are seven bars: one light blue bar representing the base model (Mistralv0.2-Base), and six colored bars (light orange to dark brown) representing models fine-tuned on each of the six specialties. The legend indicates the color coding for each specialty. For each specialty group, the fine-tuned model corresponding to that specialty (e.g., the "Cardio" fine-tuned model in the "Cardio" group) typically exhibits the lowest (most negative) log probability, indicating higher likelihood or better performance on its respective specialty terms. The base model consistently shows higher (less negative) log probabilities across all specialties, suggesting lower performance compared to fine-tuned models. The bars are arranged in groups by specialty, with each group containing one base model bar and six fine-tuned model bars, and the bars are sorted within each group from left to right by specialty in the order: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics. The chart visually emphasizes that fine-tuning improves model performance on specialty-specific terms, with the most significant improvement observed when the model is fine-tuned on the same specialty as the evaluation terms.
